Name: New NPC - Jasmine
Author: Robokit12
Description:
Meet Jasmine and explore another townies background.

[size=3]I highly recommend to start a new save file and backup your current save files BEFORE loading this mod! Your save files might crash after uninstalling this mod!

NOT compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded! 

[/size]
Name: Jasmine (22)
Birthday: Winter 12th

 
[b][size=3]Includes:[/size][/b]
- a whole bunch of Dialogues (lots of interactive ones as well)
- a unique Background Story (talk to her once a day to uncover the full story)
- Heart Events
- optional: her own room 
- does show up on festivals (cannot be invited for a dance)



[b]Loved gifts: [/b]Pancakes, Hazelnut, Sunflower, Roasted Hazelnuts
[b]Liked gifts: [/b]Cookie, Pumpkin Soup, Duck Feather
[b]Neutral gifts: [/b]all kind of flowers
[b]Disliked gifts: [/b]Garlic ,Snail, Oil of Garlic
[b]Hated gifts: [/b]Broken glasses, Rabbit´s Foot

 
[b][size=3]Heart Events[/size][/b] will be triggered at the following locations (Jasmine needs to be around!):

2 ❤❤: George´s and Evelyn´s home

[b][size=3]Known issues[/size][/b] (which cannot be fixed yet, because of modding limitations):
- Introduction won´t work after 7 days if you play with her on an existing farm
- the introduction does not affect the number of people you've greeted (but she has her own dialogue)
- given gifts do not appear in the weekly overview (she´ll appreciate your efforts though)
